name: capital-trader
description: An automated trading bot for Capital.com with chart, indicators and strategy builder.
author: NxRoot

scripts.posttypings: node -e "const {readFileSync, writeFileSync} = require('fs'); const file = require.resolve('klinecharts/types/index.d.ts'); const original = 'export as namespace klinecharts;'; const addon = 'export declare const indicators: any[];\n' + original; if(!readFileSync(file, 'utf-8').includes('export declare const indicators: any[];')) writeFileSync(file, readFileSync(file, 'utf-8').replace(original, addon));"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const {readFileSync, writeFileSync} = require('fs'); const file = require.resolve('klinecharts/dist/klinecharts.js'); const original = 'exports.version = version;'; const addon = original + '\nexports.indicators = extensions\x242;'; writeFileSync(file.replace('.js', '.min.js'), readFileSync(file, 'utf-8').replace(original, addon));" && npm run posttypings
scripts.release: npm version patch && git push && git push --tags && npm publish
